ruleDefinitions.name: Data Export From MSSQL Table Via BCP.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the execution of the BCP utility in order to export data from the database.
Attackers were seen saving their malware to a database column or table and then later extracting it via "bcp.exe" into a file.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\bcp\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "BCP\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ out\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ queryout\\ .*")))
